title: ERP Administrator
description:
1. Ensure smooth integration with other business systems and databases.

2. Manage user access, permissions, and security settings within the ERP system.

3. Provide training and support to users to ensure proper usage of the system.

4. Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues reported by users.

5. Perform regular system maintenance, including backups, updates, and patches.

6. Conduct system audits to ensure data integrity and security compliance.

7. Manage and maintain data within the ERP system, ensuring accuracy and consistency.

8. Assist in the migration of data to and from the ERP system when necessary.

9. Collaborate with various departments (finance, HR, supply chain, etc.) to understand and fulfill their ERP requirements.

10. Provide assistance with decision-making by generating customized reports from the ERP system.

11. Ensure the ERP system is secure and adheres to internal and external regulatory standards.

12. Collaborate with ERP software vendors and third-party consultants for troubleshooting, system upgrades, and new implementations.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, B Tech Diploma

ERP-specific certifications (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics) are a plus.

Experience :

Proven experience in ERP administration or a similar IT support role.

Hands-on experience with ERP software (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite).

Familiarity with system integration, troubleshooting, and data migration.

Technical Skills:

Proficient in ERP system administration, including system configuration, customization, and maintenance.

Understanding of ERP security, user access management, and data protection.
